title: kbmon's states are true: no orphan for a recorded or live headless session, no landing after land.end, a runner only with a live worker, and a silent claimed unit in needs you
goal: bl_procs.classify counts a pid recorded by backlog.py own --class process, or whose session wrote its transcript within the last 10 minutes, as detached, not orphan (a pid with neither stays orphan), so mon_sessions' sessions.orphan alert and selfcheck stop firing on healthy externally launched claude -p sessions; mon_sessions.landing_steps ignores a land.step row after the item's land.end, so a landed item never shows as in landing at verify (197 do today); role_of labels a session sprint runner only when a dispatch record's worker pid is live or one of its items' run state is working, else interactive; mon_needs adds one needs-you entry stalled-claim for a claimed item whose dispatched worker or session has been silent beyond coord.run.working_silent's 3600 s, and none for an unclaimed idle session. No new metric. Partly overlaps ST-qzknmm7z (silence over all sessions). Evidence: reliability-authority-review.md OB-1 to OB-3.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bl_procs,mon_needs;ok=('own' in inspect.getsource(bl_procs.classify)) and ('stalled-claim' in inspect.getsource(mon_needs));print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
